requirement: Publish and Back to draft keep the deployment's zone in the site's frame-ancestors: with SITE_DOMAIN=tracy.site and no FLEET_ZONE, go-live.sh writes https://*.tracy.site, not https://*.tracy.ai

oracle.ref: PR #1597 (fix); fix evidence: Measured 22/10/2026 on the dev host (zone tracy.site): the fresh draft hihehihe.tracy.site sent frame-ancestors 'self' https://*.tracy.site ... https://cowork.tracy.site; the published demos ja-diner-wordpress, ja-vega-joomla and base-joomla .tracy.site sent https://*.tracy.ai, so a shard origin (https://s1.tracy.site) could not frame them in the template gallery.
oracle.invariant: live with SITE_DOMAIN=tracy.site and no FLEET_ZONE: apache/tracy-noindex.conf carries frame-ancestors 'self' https://*.tracy.site and no tracy.ai, plus the TRACY_ORIGIN https://cowork.tracy.site. draft with the same environment: the same frame-ancestors line. FLEET_ZONE=tracy.ai with SITE_DOMAIN=tracy.site: https://*.tracy.ai (FLEET_ZONE wins, as in provision.sh). Neither set: https://*.tracy.ai. go-live.sh reads FLEET_ZONE="${FLEET_ZONE:-${SITE_DOMAIN:-tracy.ai}}" before its first tracy_write_apache_conf call.
